scenarios.title: Start of day
scenarios.goal: Inspect this customer and decide whether any evidence needs your attention.

scenarios.title: One household, two reviews
scenarios.goal: Review the home opportunity, then inspect the auto opportunity. Decide which facts apply to each.

scenarios.title: Policy timing
scenarios.goal: Determine which policy expiration date you can support from the retained source, and record your decision or explain what is missing.

scenarios.title: Changed conversation
scenarios.goal: Check the previous reviewed date against the message history and decide whether a new review is warranted.

scenarios.title: Two task records
scenarios.goal: Inspect the external obligation and local Work. Record an exact relationship only if the evidence supports it.

scenarios.title: Conversation context
scenarios.goal: Assess whether the conversation can safely support a reviewed opportunity fact and explain your next step.

scenarios.title: Policy timing and contact
scenarios.goal: Resolve the factual issue if possible, then assess what that decision means for contacting this customer.

scenarios.title: History coverage
scenarios.goal: Inspect the retained conversation and describe what you can and cannot conclude about its history.

scenarios.title: Unavailable source
scenarios.goal: Inspect the reviewed fact and determine whether its original source is still adequate support.

scenarios.title: Growing archive
scenarios.goal: Inspect capacity and determine whether further ingestion needs planning.

scenarios.title: Ingestion stopped
scenarios.goal: Identify why ingestion stopped, which thread is affected, and a preservation-safe next step.

scenarios.title: Restored review
scenarios.goal: Inspect the restored customer, original evidence and previous producer decisions. Determine what still needs attention.
